findings.issue: The new #59 checkpoint prompts reuse the released v16 UI resource URI: mcp_server.py still sets WIDGET_VERSION=16 and ui_uri hashes only the media base URL. A host caching that URI can keep the old fixed-10-second prompt after deployment, so the advertised timestamp fix is not delivered. Publish a fresh widget URI, retain the previous URI aliases, and keep bridge/version assertions and docs aligned.

summary: Fixed the medium-severity widget cache identity defect by publishing v17, preserving v15/v16 aliases, and aligning bridge assertions and docs. The regression failed before the fix; the Git Bash offline gate passed 744 tests with 24 platform skips. needs-human: #59 still requires actual ChatGPT library appearance, post-upload SHA-256 equality, and model decoding at the requested checkpoints.
